title: The Very Important Puddle
synopsis: Sam plays in a puddle, Kate notices the sky reflected in it, and Danny finds a dry way around.

related_resources.reason: Describes emerging perspective-taking in the preceding age window; does not set an age-3 performance expectation.
Emerging peer social skills and need for adult guidance. Not a directive to share any possession at any moment.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: Neither wish made the other one disappear.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Different needs can remain legitimate at the same time.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: General emerging perspective-taking, not advanced theory of mind.

rationale_citations.story_anchor:
Three friends.

One puddle.

Three different things to notice.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: The same experience can be viewed from different positions.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Editorial narrative device, not a developmental test.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: There was a strip of dry grass beside the path.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A practical alternative can meet more than one need without enforcing agreement.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Author’s invented resolution, not a prescribed conflict-management method.

source_note: The manuscript is original fictional narrative. Citations apply only to stated parent-facing developmental rationales; they do not source plots or establish an effect from listening to this story.
